2A.5 SOTP ASSUMPTION SET — JD.com (JD), FY2026E (calendar year ending Dec-2026)

Reconstructed GS-style SOTP block. Sources: GS "Navigating China Internet"
10 Aug 2026 — 12m SOTP-based TP US$43/HK$169, Buy rated; GSe 2Q26: JD Retail
profit Rmb13.5bn at 4.6% margin (2Q), new business loss Rmb-9.7bn, group net
income Rmb8.5bn; FY26E blended Retail margin set below the strong 2Q print.
FMP revenue-product-segmentation (JD Retail / JD Logistics / New Businesses)
scaled to FY26E group revenue of ~US$185bn equivalent (CNY at 0.1376).
15% holdco discount per China internet convention.
